title: FrameSample
description: One captured camera frame with its timestamps and ROI (Phase 01 contract; produced by capture, Phase 02). The image itself is referenced, not embedded. docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.1.

t_capture.description: Exposure/capture instant on t_mono (README section 5.2). Mapped from the driver clock or stamped at grab return per timestamp_source (Phase 02, Task 02.2).

t_frame_available.description: Instant the frame was handed to the application. Must be >= t_capture (checked by the consumer).

timestamp_source.description: How t_capture was obtained. DRIVER_MAPPED: driver timestamp mapped onto t_mono; GRAB_RETURN: stamped at grab return minus the camera profile's bias estimate; REPLAY: original recorded value fed by a replay source (Task 01.9).

frame_size_px.description: [width, height] of the full camera frame in pixels.

roi_px.description: Fixed playing ROI rectangle in full-frame pixels. All ROI-normalized coordinates downstream are relative to this rectangle (ADR-0005).

kind.description: MEMORY: live in-process array (not serialisable; record mode replaces it by FILE). FILE: frame stored in a video/image file.

path.description: Path relative to the session directory (FILE only).

index.description: Frame index within the file (FILE only).

crop.description: Whether the stored image is the full frame (default; authoritative for re-processing) or only the ROI crop.

camera_profile_id.description: Id of the camera profile document (Phase 02, Task 02.10) whose measured properties apply to this frame.

dropped_since_last.description: Frames dropped by the bounded capture queue since the previous delivered FrameSample (Phase 02, Task 02.3).
